row_granularity: one row per claim/incident, with one or more claimant subrows
notes: The first page contains a Commercial Package Summary with policy-period totals. Claim pages repeat the document header, including the policy number, and group claims under a repeating Term header. Each claim is a multi-line block containing claim number, line of business, loss date, loss description, status, close date, claimant(s), Outstanding loss reserve, Incurred loss, and Claim total. Claimants may span multiple lines. A Term total row closes the policy-term block; continuation pages may begin with the remainder of the preceding claim or claim total before the next claim block.
